name: Jest of the Hedge Maze
body:
School: Transmutation; Level: jester 4

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range: Personal

Target: You

Duration: 1 round

DESCRIPTION

Until the end of your next turn, if an opponent ends its turn within 5 feet of you, you may move up to your speed as an immediate action.
